newsitem.title: CHINA: Shenzhen shares end lower on interim caution.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen shares end lower on interim caution.

text.p: Shenzhen's A and B share indices closed lower on Friday as investors trod cautiously ahead of the weekend when some companies are likely to report their 1997 interim results, brokers said.
The foreign currency B share index shed 1.32 points or 0.99 percent to 131.27 on turnover of HK$31 million against Thursday's HK$34 million.
The yuan-denominated A share index fell 2.30 points or 0.56 percent to 408.12 on turnover of 5.8 billion yuan, compared with 5.2 billion yuan on Thursday.
